As I wrote, you will need 5 teams for D-tide so I would aim to diversify as much as possible before upgrading one single team ( which *is* also usefull, don't get me wrong ).

You can not put chaos, ultra and caro in the same linup : 2 realms max.
Wether you prioritize Mouchette or Caecus is enemy-dependent : Mouchette specialize in short fights and bursts while Caecus builds counter over time and takes care of multi-hit mobs

content:
Hello there ~

It *is* a game so yeah, you can play with whatever you like <:Saya_caught:1513123193341349968> 

Some awakeners are very versatile, amazing supports or heavy damage-dealer but in the end you can make just about anyone shine so long as you invest in them.

Don't forget to try them out first though, either under the "record" button from home page or by borrowing them in events.

As for where to pull from I'd recommand you go for stars cradled close first until you got 3 awakeners or 2 wheels, then switch to moonless. There's little use in selecting the same awakeners on both banners. In any case, you can wait until you're done with one banner to choose your awakeners on the other
Did you find Cheri's handbook ? It's a treasure of intel for newcommers ( just type /new if you didn't )
Finally, you will eventually want *at least* 19 awakeners you enjoy so don't be shy about spending cores in realm study for all 4 realms

You normally don't pair Saya with Castor, as Castor wants his Onyx Plumes to stay on hand for additional Shield at turn-end or for a big attack turn. You want Saya on teams that take advantage of her Discard and Corrosion, such as with Aurita (0-cost attacks) or Sanga (big nuke Exalt).

Castor and Pollux work together as they are designed to complement each other's strengths. Faint is a good pick-me-up especially for Death Res procs. 

Putting Saya on other teams also helps you so you have access to base Caro Realm for faster heals and Embryo generation. This is because she turns the realm Propagation: Caro, which is difficult to play around with for newer accounts and players. It gives a 3-turn cooldown per heal, changes Embryo away from providing Crit on character use, and wants you to stay at low HP to maximize its effects. Plus, Castor already provides Corrosion and some card draw by playing his Onyx Plumes, which makes Saya's kit at odds with Castor and Pollux's gameplay loop.

 A teammate I would suggest to strengthen your Castor team is either Agrippa from Caro Standard or Erica from the Exchange Shop. Agrippa gives you faster Embryo generation and stronger Castor shields by providing permanent Alert when her Exalt consumes an Embryo. Erica is more situational and tricky to play with, but she also provides a lot of temporary Alert when you need it. 

(Alert gives additional points of Shield per trigger, such as when playing Defense. Since you can retain a lot of Castor's Onyx Plumes and they trigger shields at turn end, 5 Alert with 4 Plumes mean 20 free shield on top of what you normally get. Agrippa and Erica provide these abundantly, moreso if you pair both of them with Castor.)

Summary:

Castor and Pollux works well as a duo.

Saya doesn't synergize with Castor as she removes his Plumes which he wants to keep on hand.

Castor works well with Agrippa (Standard) and Erica (Shop).

Saya is good with Aurita, who can trigger her Corrosion a lot and would want the discard mechanic of Saya's 0-cost.

Faint is a cutie and definitely helps with survivability via her Death Res stacks and base-Caro's healing, plus the Aliemus and temporary Crit on Embryo feeding to Pollux/Castor/teammates.
